answer: Resist fake identities with a slashing grove. Each identity posts collateral and earns weight only from tenure and uncorrelated attestations — every new sparrow starts as a fledgling with capped influence. At dawn the fault audit jointly slashes collateral across correlated identities: N clones misbehaving together lose ~N^2 times the base stake. Splitting multiplies the slashing surface while dividing influence, so a botnet cannot pool the cost away. Minting sparrow identities by the thousand locks a fortune that evaporates when their behavior correlates; honesty is the only cheap strategy.
